title: H5OINA: The Latest Updates to Oxford Instruments’ Open-Source File Format
content: It has been a few years since the introduction of the H5OINA file format within Oxford Instruments' AZtec ecosystem [1] (including AZtec, AZtec Crystal [2], Relate and the Raman Project software). This format, based on the well-established Hierarchical Data Format 5 (HDF5), allows for open-source microanalysis data exchange and export to third-party software and libraries. Unlike proprietary file formats, H5OINA provides independence from internal software updates and ensures backward compatibility. The latest advancements in H5OINA have been influenced by the release of our Unity detector two years ago and are designed to enhance advanced data analysis. More detailed information about the data structure can be found on the regularly updated GitHub repository for each AZtec release [3].
